quarterly_data.quarter: MACOM press release: MACOM Introduces 3.2T Chipset Solution for High Speed (09-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: MACOM announced a front-end chipset for 3.2T optical interconnects: up to 3.2T throughput over eight channels at 448 Gbps PAM-4, combining new MATA-42754 and MATA-41754 quad linear TIAs and the MARP-BP224 backside-illuminated PIN photodiode (greater than 100 GHz bandwidth) on the receive side with its previously introduced MAOM-025408 and MAOM-022404 448 Gbps PAM-4 drivers on the transmit side, so customers get transmit and receive building blocks from a single supplier. MACOM states all products in the 3.2T chipset are readily available. CEO Stephen Daly: the chipset 'has been engineered and optimized as a platform', reducing customers' development and qualification efforts.
quarterly_data.figure: 3.2T over eight channels at 448 Gbps PAM-4; photodiode greater than 100 GHz bandwidth; all products readily available
